query:
SELECT EXISTS(
                    SELECT 1 FROM region.village v
                    JOIN region.district d ON d.id = v.district_id
                    JOIN region.regency  r ON r.id = d.regency_id
                    WHERE v.id = $1 AND d.id = $2 AND r.id = $3 AND r.province_id = $4
                ) AS "exists!"
